files.description: Shipments (400 rows): shipment_id (whole number), ordered_on and shipped_on (dates as text, YYYY-MM-DD, in 2025; shipped_on is empty for about 4% of rows that have not shipped yet), carrier (DHL, UPS, PostNord or GLS; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), weight_kg (one decimal), value (order value, two decimals).

task_text: Read the shipments file with both date columns parsed as dates. Then, for every date column in the table, replace the date by the number of days since 2025-01-01 (missing dates stay missing). `result` should be the whole table with the converted columns.
intended_computation: Convert ordered_on and shipped_on to whole days since 2025-01-01 (shipped_on empty for 16 rows stays missing), keep the other columns unchanged, 400 rows in file order.

acceptable_variants.notes: the day counts may be integers or floats.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.1 the type name 'datetime64[ns]' no longer matches the parsed date columns, so nothing is converted

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
